intro: Yemen has a rich heritage of architecture, poetry and music.

chapters.title: Mud-brick towers
text: Shibam, in Hadhramaut, is called the 'Manhattan of the desert' for its mud-brick tower houses up to 30 m tall. Sanaa's old city has houses decorated with white gypsum patterns.

chapters.title: Food and coffee
text: Saltah, a bubbling stew with fenugreek froth, is the national dish. Yemeni coffee and honey are famous.

keyTerms.meaning: A white mineral used for decoration.
